item.CODE:
* Check PO3 TMKEY = ICSL * e.g. SDSLS_IC_NEW_TMKEY_PO3_CHECK
constants: lc_tm_ctrl_key_ico_po3 type tm_ctrl_key value 'ICSL', lc_vctype_ic type vcm_value_chain_type value 'IC_SALES', lc_status_completed type vcm_value_chain_step_status value 'C', lc_sosc_step_type_id type vcm_step_type_id value 'SOSC', lc_poic_step_type_id type vcm_step_type_id value 'POIC', lc_soic_step_type_id type vcm_step_type_id value 'SOIC'.
rv_check_status = abap_true.
" get SO2 from reference step data: lt_sales_key type table of vbeln. data(ls_step_data) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = iv_step_number ). loop at ls_step_data-reference_step assigning field-symbol(<lv_ref_step>). data(lt_ptf_keys) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_keys_of_touch_doc_of_step( iv_step_number = <lv_ref_step> ). append lines of lt_ptf_keys to lt_sales_key. endloop. if lt_sales_key[] is initial. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: No SO2 found| ). return. endif. data: lt_vbap type table of vbap. call function 'SD_VBAP_ARRAY_READ_VBELN' tables it_vbak_key = lt_sales_key et_vbap = lt_vbap exceptions records_not_found = 1 records_not_requested = 2 others = 3. if sy-subrc <> 0. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: No items found in SO2| ). return. endif.
" get PO3 for SO2 data(lo_vcm_integration) = cl_sd_sls_vcm_factory=>so_instance->get_instance_vcm_integration( ). data lt_predecessor_item type if_vcm_value_chain_item_read=>tt_bo_item. loop at lt_vbap assigning field-symbol(<fs_source_item>). insert value #( step_type = lc_sosc_step_type_id object_id = <fs_source_item>-vbeln item_id = <fs_source_item>-posnr ) into table lt_predecessor_item. endloop.
lo_vcm_integration->get_vcm_item_link( exporting it_predecessor_item = lt_predecessor_item iv_target_vcm_step_type_id = lc_poic_step_type_id importing et_item_link = data(lt_item_link) ).
data: lv_ebeln type ebeln. data: lt_po_key type table of ebeln. loop at lt_item_link assigning field-symbol(<fs_item_link>). lv_ebeln = <fs_item_link>-item-object_id. collect lv_ebeln into lt_po_key. endloop.
" ------------------------------------------ check TMKEY for PO3 ----- data: lv_po3_tm_ctrl_key type poext-tm_ctrl_key. loop at lt_po_key assigning field-symbol(<fs_ebeln>). " check TMKEY for PO3 clear: lv_po3_tm_ctrl_key. select single tm_ctrl_key from poext into lv_po3_tm_ctrl_key where ebeln = <fs_ebeln> and ebelp = '00000'. if lv_po3_tm_ctrl_key <> lc_tm_ctrl_key_ico_po3. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: PO3 { <fs_ebeln> } TMKEY { lv_po3_tm_ctrl_key } not as expected { lc_tm_ctrl_key_ico_po3 }| ). else. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Success: PO3 { <fs_ebeln> } TMKEY { lv_po3_tm_ctrl_key } as expected| ). endif. endloop.

item.CODE:
* Check SO4 that Incoterm location fields are in sync with PO3 * e.g. SDSLS_IC_NEW_TMLOC_SO4_CHECK
types: begin of lty_po_inco_st, ebeln type ebeln, ebelp type ebelp, inco1 type ekpo-inco1, inco2_l type ekpo-inco2_l, inco3_l type ekpo-inco3_l, inco2_key type ekpo-inco2_key, inco3_key type ekpo-inco3_key, inco4_key type ekpo-inco4_key, end of lty_po_inco_st.
constants: lc_vctype_ic type vcm_value_chain_type value 'IC_SALES', lc_steptype_soic type vcm_step_type_id value 'SOIC', lc_status_completed type vcm_value_chain_step_status value 'C', lc_so_header type posnr_va value '000000'.
data: lt_sales_key type table of vbeln.
rv_check_status = abap_true.
" get SO4 from reference step data(ls_step_data) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = iv_step_number ). loop at ls_step_data-reference_step assigning field-symbol(<lv_ref_step>). data(lt_ptf_keys) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_keys_of_touch_doc_of_step( iv_step_number = <lv_ref_step> ). append lines of lt_ptf_keys to lt_sales_key. endloop. if lt_sales_key[] is initial. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: No SO4 found| ). return. endif.
" get PO3 for SO4 data: lt_po_key type table of ebeln. select bstnk from vbak into table lt_po_key for all entries in lt_sales_key where vbeln = lt_sales_key-table_line. delete lt_po_key where table_line is initial. sort lt_po_key. delete adjacent duplicates from lt_po_key. if lt_po_key[] is initial. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: No PO3 found| ). return. endif.
" read incoterms for SO4 data: lt_vbkd type table of vbkd. select vbeln posnr inco1 inco2_l inco3_l inco2_key inco3_key inco4_key from vbkd into corresponding fields of table lt_vbkd for all entries in lt_sales_key where vbeln = lt_sales_key-table_line.
" read incoterms for PO3 data: lt_ekko type table of lty_po_inco_st. data: lt_ekpo type table of lty_po_inco_st. select ebeln inco1 inco2_l inco3_l inco2_key inco3_key inco4_key from ekko into corresponding fields of table lt_ekko for all entries in lt_po_key where ebeln = lt_po_key-table_line. select ebeln ebelp inco1 inco2_l inco3_l inco2_key inco3_key inco4_key from ekpo into corresponding fields of table lt_ekpo for all entries in lt_po_key where ebeln = lt_po_key-table_line and inco1 <> space.
" read link between PO3 and SO4 items data: lt_vcmhm_chain type table of vcmhm_chain. data: lt_vcm_boid type table of vcm_business_object_id. lt_vcm_boid[] = lt_sales_key[]. select * from vcmhm_chain into corresponding fields of table lt_vcmhm_chain for all entries in lt_vcm_boid where value_chain_type = lc_vctype_ic and step_type = lc_steptype_soic and valuechainstepinstancestatus = lc_status_completed and business_object_id = lt_vcm_boid-table_line. if lt_vcmhm_chain[] is initial. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: document flow not found for SO4 in VCMHM_CHAIN| ). return. endif. sort lt_vcmhm_chain by business_object_id business_object_item_id.
" --------------------------- check SO4 incoterms = PO3 incoterms ----- data: lv_ebeln type ekpo-ebeln. data: lv_ebelp type ekpo-ebelp. data: lv_vbeln type vbap-vbeln. data: lv_posnr type vbap-posnr. field-symbols: <fs_so_inco> type vbkd. field-symbols: <fs_vcmhm_chain> type vcmhm_chain. field-symbols: <fs_po_inco> type lty_po_inco_st.
loop at lt_vcmhm_chain assigning <fs_vcmhm_chain>.
lv_vbeln = <fs_vcmhm_chain>-business_object_id. lv_posnr = <fs_vcmhm_chain>-business_object_item_id. lv_ebeln = <fs_vcmhm_chain>-predecessor_id. lv_ebelp = <fs_vcmhm_chain>-predecessor_item_id.
" get SO4 inco assign lt_vbkd[ vbeln = lv_vbeln posnr = lv_posnr ] to <fs_so_inco>. if sy-subrc <> 0. if line_exists( lt_ekpo[ ebeln = lv_vbeln ebelp = lv_ebelp ] ). rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: Incoterm PO3 { lv_ebeln } { lv_ebelp } not copied to SO4 { lv_vbeln } { lv_posnr }| ). exit. else. " if inco in PO3 only in header -> take SO4 header for comparison assign lt_vbkd[ vbeln = lv_vbeln posnr = lc_so_header ] to <fs_so_inco>. endif. endif.
" get PO3 inco assign lt_ekpo[ ebeln = lv_ebeln ebelp = lv_ebelp ] to <fs_po_inco>. if sy-subrc <> 0. assign lt_ekko[ ebeln = lv_ebeln ] to <fs_po_inco>. endif. if sy-subrc <> 0. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: PO3 { lv_ebeln } { lv_ebelp } incoterms not found| ). exit. endif.
" compare SO4 incoterm with PO3 incoterm if <fs_so_inco>-inco1 <> <fs_po_inco>-inco1. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: SO4 INCO1 { <fs_so_inco>-inco1 } different from PO3 { <fs_po_inco>-inco1 }| ). exit. endif.
if <fs_so_inco>-inco2_l <> <fs_po_inco>-inco2_l. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: SO4 INCO2_L { <fs_so_inco>-inco2_l } different from PO3 { <fs_po_inco>-inco2_l }| ). exit. endif.
if <fs_so_inco>-inco3_l <> <fs_po_inco>-inco3_l. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: SO4 INCO3_L { <fs_so_inco>-inco3_l } different from PO3 { <fs_po_inco>-inco3_l }| ). exit. endif.
if <fs_so_inco>-inco2_key <> <fs_po_inco>-inco2_key. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: SO4 INCO2_KEY different from PO3 | ). exit. endif.
if <fs_so_inco>-inco3_key <> <fs_po_inco>-inco3_key. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: SO4 INCO3_KEY different from PO3 | ). exit. endif.
if <fs_so_inco>-inco4_key <> <fs_po_inco>-inco4_key. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: SO4 INCO4_KEY different from PO3 | ). exit. endif.
endloop.
if rv_check_status = abap_true. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Success: SO4 incoterms identical with PO3 | ). endif.
item.DESCRIPTION: Check SO4 Incoterm location fields are in sync with PO3

item.VAR_DESC: STO TM relevant, 1 Item, Check PO3 TMKEY

item.CODE:
* Check PO3/SO4 TMKEY as expected * e.g. SDSLS_IC_NEW_TMKEY_STO_A, SDSLS_IC_NEW_TMKEY_STO_B types: begin of ty_po_tmkey_st, ebeln type ebeln, bsart type ekko-bsart, ekorg type ekorg, ekgrp type ekgrp, tm_ctrl_key_ist type tms_c_pur-tm_ctrl_key, tm_ctrl_key_soll type poext-tm_ctrl_key, end of ty_po_tmkey_st.
data: lt_sales_key type table of vbeln.
rv_check_status = abap_true.
" get SO4 from reference step data(ls_step_data) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = iv_step_number ). loop at ls_step_data-reference_step assigning field-symbol(<lv_ref_step>). data(lt_ptf_keys) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_keys_of_touch_doc_of_step( iv_step_number = <lv_ref_step> ). append lines of lt_ptf_keys to lt_sales_key. endloop. if lt_sales_key[] is initial. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: No SO4 found| ). return. endif.
" get PO3 for SO4 data: lt_po_key type table of ebeln. select bstnk from vbak into table lt_po_key for all entries in lt_sales_key where vbeln = lt_sales_key-table_line. delete lt_po_key where table_line is initial. sort lt_po_key. delete adjacent duplicates from lt_po_key. if lt_po_key[] is initial. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: No PO3 found| ). return. endif.
" ------------------- check PO3 TMKEY as expected ----- data: ls_po_tmkey type ty_po_tmkey_st. loop at lt_po_key into data(lv_ebeln). clear: ls_po_tmkey. select single k~ebeln k~bsart k~ekorg k~ekgrp e~tm_ctrl_key t~tm_ctrl_key from ekko as k inner join poext as e on k~ebeln = e~ebeln left outer join tms_c_pur as t on k~ekorg = t~ekorg and k~ekgrp = t~ekgrp and k~bsart = t~bsart into ( ls_po_tmkey-ebeln, ls_po_tmkey-bsart, ls_po_tmkey-ekorg, ls_po_tmkey-ekgrp, ls_po_tmkey-tm_ctrl_key_ist, ls_po_tmkey-tm_ctrl_key_soll ) where k~ebeln = lv_ebeln. if sy-subrc <> 0. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: PO3 { lv_ebeln } TM control key not found| ). exit. endif. if ls_po_tmkey-tm_ctrl_key_ist <> ls_po_tmkey-tm_ctrl_key_soll. rv_check_status = abap_false. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( |Error: PO3 TM control key { ls_po_tmkey-tm_ctrl_key_ist } not as expected { ls_po_tmkey-tm_ctrl_key_soll }| ). exit. endif. endloop.
